_instructions: DNFL Last Team Standing (LTS) & High Score Rules Configuration
1. 'default': Mandatory baseline rules applied across all conferences.
2. 'conferenceOverrides': Optional conference-specific overrides keyed by 2-digit ID ('00', '01').
- 'lts_isEnabled' (boolean): true = enable LTS survival eliminations; false = disable.
- 'highScore_isEnabled' (boolean): true = indicate weekly high scorer winner; false = disable.
